blocks.text:
Fourteen days through Colombia’s most iconic places: the historic heart of Bogotá, the Salt Cathedral and the legend of El Dorado at Guatavita; Medellín, Comuna 13 and the colourful town of Guatapé; the coffee farms, wax palms and villages of the Coffee Region; the walled city of Cartagena and the Rosario Islands; and finally Santa Marta and the beaches of Tayrona National Park.

Included
–   Airport – hotel – airport and internal transfers; Cartagena – Santa Marta transfer
–   3 nights in Bogotá, 3 in Medellín, 2 in Pereira, 3 in Cartagena and 2 in Santa Marta
–   13 breakfasts and 4 lunches
–   Bogotá: city tour and Monserrate; Guatavita and Zipaquirá (private)
–   Medellín: city tour, Metro, Metrocable and Graffitour; El Peñol and Guatapé with moto-taxi (private)
–   Pereira: coffee farm experience; Salento and Cocora Valley (private)
–   Cartagena: city tour (private); sunset cruise and Rosario Islands (shared)
–   Santa Marta: city tour (private); Tayrona full day to Cabo San Juan (shared)
–   English-speaking guide · Local medical assistance card
